title: LANCET: An open-source sub-$50 one-pot cartridge with dual-threshold paraffin-wax valves for sequential RPA-Cas12a diagnostics
description: Hardware design files, Arduino firmware, and validation protocols for the Lambert iGEM 2025 LANCET cartridge: a 3D-printed three-compartment polycarbonate tube with two paraffin-mineral oil wax valves (10:7 mass ratio melting at 45 C; 10:8 melting at 50 C), driven by an Arduino Uno + N-MOSFET + DS18B20 thermal controller running a five-phase protocol for sequential RPA, Cas12a, and reporter incubations. Companion repository for the HardwareX paper.
